tests.name: ledger completion route rejects an anonymous write on staging (enforce; VTID-00000 does not exist, so nothing is written)

tests.reason: The change is the production deploy step that sets LEDGER_WRITE_AUTH_MODE; this suite runs that step's shell on a fixture task definition (unset gives log, enforce gives enforce) and proves an anonymous allocate gets 401 with nothing allocated. Production is never probed.
